scope.gate: Phase 1~6 result consolidation + production readiness inventory

collective_conclusion: Phase 1~6 validated that real crawler output can be planned, compared, converted, and guarded-applied into the normalized personal-dev ingest path with duplicate/orphan sanity checks. They did not prove national coverage completeness, deeper observation quality, review backlog policy, cleanup execution, or production/main readiness.

phases.purpose: Establish the normalized ingest/schema safety baseline used by later roadmap work.
validated: Normalized ingest direction was sufficient for later guarded apply exercises.
Later Phase 3 and Phase 6 evidence shows the baseline supports notice, occurrence, target, asset, and keyword-match writes.
phases.db_write_status: No Gate 1 DB write. Phase 1 was treated as already PASS in the adopted roadmap state.
phases.remaining_risk: Production deployment readiness deferred to Phase 7 Gate 3.

phases.purpose: Validate local planning and guarded candidate handling before DB-backed mini apply.
validated: Local-only planning flow was sufficient to feed later read-only comparison and guarded apply work.
Scope controls carried forward into Phase 3, Phase 5, and Phase 6.
phases.db_write_status: No Gate 1 DB write. Phase 2 was treated as already PASS in the adopted roadmap state.
phases.remaining_risk: Broader source observation and review policy deferred to Phase 7 Gate 2 and Gate 3.

phases.purpose: Prove a DB-backed real-source mini apply to personal-dev only.
validated: A real crawler-output candidate could be selected only after source and source-target coverage were confirmed.
The guarded normalized ingest executor could write a real-source notice path to personal-dev.
No-assets alone was treated as a warning, not an automatic blocker.
not_validated: Same-turn live crawl matching reliability for the selected source.
phases.db_write_status: Phase 3 wrote to personal-dev DB before Gate 1; Gate 1 itself did not write.
phases.remaining_risk: Scale-up and full output planning carried to Phase 4-6.

phases.purpose: Run a full source-inventory crawl dry-run without DB writes.
validated: 613 sources were covered by the dry-run inventory.
606 sources crawled at least one list item.
179 scholarship-matched notice items were produced locally.
not_validated: Lifecycle/missing judgments for failure or zero-crawled sources.
phases.remaining_risk: Gate 2 must handle observation depth, zero-match source analysis, and source-health risk.

phases.purpose: Classify the Phase 4 full output using read-only personal-dev comparison and prepare a bounded Phase 6 candidate plan.
validated: The initial zero-candidate state was traced to missing personal-dev source metadata baseline, not output shape or source-key mismatch.
Metadata-only readiness remediation allowed the read-only comparison to classify candidates.
84 clean Phase 6 candidates were selected from 179 input items.
phases.db_write_status: Read-only comparison plus metadata readiness remediation occurred before Gate 1; Gate 1 itself did not write.
phases.remaining_risk: Duplicate/review, quality-review, and no-assets quality policy carried to Gate 3.

phases.purpose: Explain the 613 -> 179 -> 84 funnel and determine whether clean84 is meaningful for guarded ingest validation.
validated: 84 candidates came from 84 distinct source keys.
Source-key concentration was not excessive for ingest-path validation.
The 84-candidate set is meaningful for mechanics validation, not completeness.

phases.purpose: Apply only the clean84 candidate set to personal-dev through the guarded normalized ingest executor.
validated: 84 requested candidates applied successfully.
84 distinct source keys were represented.
Post-apply duplicate and orphan sanity checks passed.
Main relationship-table write paths were exercised.
not_validated: Review-only, duplicate-review, unsafe, blocked, or quality-review items.
phases.db_write_status: Phase 6 wrote to personal-dev DB before Gate 1; Gate 1 itself did not write.
phases.remaining_risk: Coverage and operational readiness carried to Phase 7 Gate 2 and Gate 3.

gate2.reason: Phase 4 observed at most one list item per source, so pagination depth and older notice discovery remain unproven.
The available output cannot distinguish no recent scholarship notice from matcher or selector false negatives for every zero-match source.
Two explicit failures, five zero-crawled/no-error sources, and 427 crawled-but-zero-match sources need source-health analysis.
Gate 2 should run or design deeper observation before any production completeness claim.

gate3.reason: Shared-board and duplicate/provenance policy remains outside the clean84 apply.
Short body and extraction-quality cases remain excluded until quality policy is resolved.
No-assets alone was not an ingest blocker, but it remains a product-quality and review-readiness risk.
Cleanup SQL was neither generated nor executed; rollback execution remains unproven.
Source-scoped run traceability was validated, but aggregate production batch monitoring still needs a Gate 3 decision.
Coverage and operational risks must be closed or explicitly accepted before production/main use.

gate2_input_package.use: Primary Phase 4 dry-run result and source coverage summary.
Raw local dry-run output for per-source and matched notice inspection.
Machine summary of the Phase 4 dry-run.
Human-readable source/item funnel and observation-risk analysis.
Machine-readable funnel metrics for Gate 2 analysis.
Context for what ingest mechanics validated; not coverage proof.
Machine-readable Phase 6 apply result; context only.

decision.reason: Required Phase 3-6 and Phase 4-5 evidence files are present and non-contradictory; unresolved risks are routed to Gate 2 or Gate 3.
